model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 417 West 7th Street in Columbia, Tennessee, as the Pharmacist’s Mate First Class John Harlan Willis Post Office Building.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Andrew Ogles (R-TN)

summary.text: The bill would rename the U.S. Postal Service facility at 417 West 7th Street in Columbia, Tennessee, in honor of Pharmacist's Mate First Class John Harlan Willis.
